botIdentity.hasIdentityDescription: Bot flow actions on this server are attributed to this name in TeamSpeak's own logs and notifications, instead of the same identity your own manual actions in this app use.
botIdentity.noIdentityDescription: Optional: give bot flows their own separate ServerQuery identity, so their actions (e.g. renaming a channel) show up under this name in TeamSpeak's own logs instead of blurring together with your own manual actions in this app. Nothing changes for bot flows until you create one.
botIdentity.scopeFixHint: Bot flow actions failing with a permission or "out of scope" error? This identity may have been created before a scope fix - use "Fix Permissions" below to reissue its key without changing anything else.

youtube.title: YouTube Cookies
youtube.description: Upload a cookies.txt file to access age-restricted or member-only YouTube content. You can export cookies from your browser using extensions like
youtube.cookiesRejected: YouTube rejected these cookies ({{size}}) — re-export and re-upload
youtube.uploadedButRejected: Uploaded, but YouTube rejected these cookies
youtube.savedButRejected: Saved, but YouTube rejected these cookies
youtube.playedSongStorageDescriptionPart1: Controls what happens to songs downloaded via chat commands (
youtube.playedSongStorageDescriptionPart2: ). This does not affect songs added deliberately through the Library tab (upload or "download by URL") — those are always kept.
youtube.keepOnDescription: On: chat-played songs can be picked up into the library by "Scan for New Files" and kept indefinitely (default).
youtube.keepOffDescription: Off: chat-played songs are never added to the library and are deleted automatically about an hour after playing, to save disk space.

streaming.title: Stream Defaults
streaming.descriptionUsage: uses when nobody names a quality. Naming one in the chat ({{names}}) still wins for that stream. Higher values need more upload bandwidth and more CPU on this machine, so if viewers report stuttering, come back here and lower them.
streaming.volumeHint: Percent of the video's own loudness, 0-100. Videos are mastered far louder than people speak, so a stream at its own level arrives as a shout — hence the low default. Viewers can still turn their own player up. Takes effect on the next stream, not the running one.

debug.loggingDescription: Extra verbose logging for diagnosing issues. Leave these off during normal operation — they can produce a lot of log output. Changes take effect immediately.
debug.voiceBotDebugHint: Per-second audio streaming stats (jitter, frame timing) for music/stream bots.
debug.rankCheckDebugHint: Per-client detail (computed hours, group membership) for the Rank Check bot-flow action.
debug.serverQueryDebugHint: Every WebQuery/SSH command sent to a TeamSpeak server and its raw response, including errors (e.g. insufficient permissions) - useful when a bot flow action silently doesn't do what's expected.
debug.idResetHint: SQLite's id counters never go back down on their own, even after deleting everything - these wipe a table entirely (across every server, not just the one selected above) so its next entry starts back at #1.
debug.resetRadioIdsHint: Deletes every radio station on every server.
debug.resetBotIdsHint: Stops and deletes every music bot on every server.
debug.radioIdsResetFailed: Failed to reset radio station IDs
debug.botIdsResetFailed: Failed to reset music bot IDs
debug.resetRadioDescription: This permanently deletes every radio station on every server. They will need to be re-added.
debug.resetBotsDescription: This stops and permanently deletes every music bot on every server. They will need to be re-created.

restart.title: Scheduled Restart
restart.descriptionPart1: Periodically restart ts6-manager's own containers to clear memory and ensure a clean runtime state. This does
restart.descriptionPart2: restart your TeamSpeak server — only ts6-manager itself. Pick at least one container below to enable it.

sso.title: Single Sign-On (OIDC)
sso.descriptionPart1: Let users log in via an external OpenID Connect provider (Authentik, Keycloak, Authelia, Zitadel, ...). A brand-new user is created as a
sso.descriptionPart2: on their first SSO login — promote them to admin afterward from the Users tab if needed. Local username/password login stays available alongside this.
sso.enabledHint: Shows a "Sign in with SSO" button on the login page.
sso.issuerUrlHint: The provider's OIDC discovery document must be reachable at
sso.clientSecretPlaceholderExisting: Leave blank to keep the existing secret
sso.redirectUriHint: Redirect URI to register at your provider:

updateStatus.title: Update Status
updateStatus.comparisonHintSuffix: branch. Notify-only — nothing here runs an update automatically.
updateStatus.githubTokenDescriptionPrefix: Optional. This check reads three small files from GitHub per run, which is fine within GitHub's unauthenticated limit of 60 requests/hour — but that budget is shared with anything else on this server calling GitHub's API, and "Recheck Now" is throttled to 20/hour without a token to stay inside it. Add a token (a plain
updateStatus.githubTokenDescriptionSuffix: with no repository access needed, since it only reads public files) to raise that to 5,000 requests/hour.
updateStatus.tokenConfiguredPlaceholder: Configured — leave blank and Save does nothing
updateStatus.noTokenConfiguredHint: No token configured — using the unauthenticated limit.

placeholderReference.dialogIntro: Use <1>{{placeholder}}</1> in any text field. Values are resolved at runtime.

event.intro: Fields from the triggering TS3 event. Available fields depend on the event type.

invokerid.desc: Client ID of who made the change

invokername.desc: Name of who made the change

time.intro: Current date and time. Respects the timezone configured on the Cron trigger (falls back to UTC).

var.intro: Persistent variables stored in the database. Survive restarts. Scoped per flow. Set via the <1>Set Variable</1> action node.
var.actionSet: <0>Set</0> — Set a variable to a fixed value or template
var.actionIncrement: <0>Increment</0> — Add a number to the current value
var.actionAppend: <0>Append</0> — Append text to the current value
var.example1: Visit counter: Increment <1>visit_count</1> by 1 on each join

temp.intro: Temporary variables that only exist during a single flow execution. Automatically set by certain action nodes. Supports nested access via dot notation.

lastCreatedChannelId.desc: CID of channel created by Create Channel

lastResult.desc: Raw JSON result from WebQuery action

afkMovedCount.desc: Number of clients moved by AFK Mover

idleKickedCount.desc: Number of clients kicked by Idle Kicker

pokedCount.desc: Number of clients poked by Poke Group

rankPromotedCount.desc: Number of clients promoted by Rank Check

tempChannelsDeleted.desc: Number of channels deleted by Temp Cleanup

temp.storeAsIntro: WebQuery and HTTP Request actions have a "Store As" field. The FULL result list is saved as a temp variable — even a single-row command like clientinfo or serverinfo, so access it with an explicit <1>.0.</1> for "the first (only) row".
temp.loopIntro: A Loop node reads an existing list (e.g. a "Store As" result from a clientlist WebQuery) and runs its "Body" output once per item, then its "After" output once when done.

loopItem.desc: Current item (whatever name the Loop node's Item Variable Name is set to), inside its Body branch only

loopField.desc: A field of the current item - item variable name + "." + field (no .0 here, unlike Store As above - a single object per iteration, not a list)

loopIndex.desc: Position of the current item in the list, starting at 0

exec.intro: Read-only metadata about the current flow execution.

flowId.desc: ID of the flow being executed

filter.intro: Filters transform values. Apply with pipe syntax: <1>{{value|filter}}</1>

functions.intro: Functions for use in <1>Condition</1> node expressions. Return 0 or 1 (false/true).

contains.desc: String contains substring? (plain substring match - see hasGroup below for numeric ID lists)

split.desc: Split string and get element at index

hasGroup.desc: Exact match against a comma-separated ID list - use this for server group IDs, not contains(), which would wrongly match group '1' against '10' or '21' too

count.desc: Row count of a stored WebQuery result (array), or string length otherwise - use to check whether a lookup found anything

templates.intro: Extra placeholders specific templates from the Template Gallery resolve automatically, beyond the general ones above.

editChannelDialog.encryptVoice: Encrypt voice data in this channel
editChannelDialog.defaultChannelHint: A server has only one default channel — enabling this removes the flag from whichever channel currently has it.
editChannelDialog.maxFamilyClientsHint: Limits clients across this channel and all its sub-channels combined.
editChannelDialog.sortPositionHint: The channel ID this one should be positioned directly below among its siblings (0 = first). Channel IDs are shown as "#id" in the channel tree.
editChannelDialog.phoneticNamePlaceholder: How text-to-speech should pronounce this channel's name

infoChannels.label: Info Channels
infoChannels.description: Dynamic channel names with live data

clockChannel.name: Clock Channel
clockChannel.description: Updates a channel name with the current time every minute.

onlineCounter.name: Online Counter
onlineCounter.description: Shows the current online client count in a channel name.

serverStats.name: Server Stats
serverStats.description: Displays uptime, online clients, and channel count in three info channels.

animatedChannel.name: Animated Channel Name
animatedChannel.description: Animates a channel name with visual effects like scrolling marquee, typewriter, bounce, and more. Updates every 2-5 seconds.

welcomeMessage.name: Welcome Message
welcomeMessage.description: Sends a welcome message or poke when a client joins the server, with an opt-out command and server-group exclusions.
variablesHint: {{temp.onlineCount}} - real users online right now (query/bot connections not counted)
{{temp.teamOnline}} - team members online right now (only resolves if Team Groups is set below)

supportSystem.name: Support System
supportSystem.description: Notifies admins when a client joins the support channel.

privateChannelCreator.name: Private Channel Creator
privateChannelCreator.description: Creates a persistent private channel for a client on first joining a lobby, and moves them back to it every time after - with them set as its channel owner.
variablesHint: {{temp.joinerInfo.0.client_nickname}} - joining client's name (for the channel name/description template)

parentChannelId.label: Parent Channel ID (optional - overrides where channels are created)

channelAdminGroupId.label: Channel Admin Group ID (assigned as owner)

spamProtectionEnabled.label: Spam Protection (ban clients who repeatedly rejoin the lobby)

autoRank.name: Auto-Rank
autoRank.description: Automatically assigns server groups based on cumulative online time.

lastSeenTracker.name: Last-Seen Tracker
lastSeenTracker.description: Records the last-seen timestamp when a client disconnects.

afkMover.name: AFK Mover
afkMover.description: Moves idle clients to an AFK channel after a configurable timeout.

idleKicker.name: Idle Kicker
idleKicker.description: Kicks clients that have been idle for too long.

badNameChecker.name: Bad Name Checker
badNameChecker.description: Kicks clients whose nickname contains forbidden words.

groupProtector.name: Group Protector
groupProtector.description: Kicks clients who have a protected group but lack the required authorization group.

webhookServerMessage.name: Webhook → Server Message
webhookServerMessage.description: Receives a webhook POST and broadcasts the message to the TeamSpeak server. Great for monitoring alerts, CI/CD notifications, or Discord bridges.

webhookGroupAssign.name: Webhook → Assign Group
webhookGroupAssign.description: External system (e.g. website verification) sends a webhook with a client database ID to assign a server group. Use for website-to-TS3 user verification.

webhookChannelRename.name: Webhook → Update Channel
webhookChannelRename.description: Receives a webhook and updates a channel name. Use for external status displays like game server status, stream status, or monitoring dashboards.

antiVpn.name: Anti-VPN
antiVpn.description: Checks connecting clients against a VPN detection API and kicks/bans VPN users.
